requirements.RC-1249: Professional PDF export carries explicit watermark policy state.
requirements.RC-1250: A full PRO professional report may disable watermarking.
requirements.RC-1251: A Free sample report requires an enabled demo watermark.
requirements.RC-1252: A Free user may generate only the isolated demo/sample PDF path.
requirements.RC-1253: The Free sample is explicitly classified as demo rather than a real-client report.
requirements.RC-1254: Free entitlement cannot authorize a real-client PDF export.
requirements.RC-1255: PRO entitlement can authorize a real-client PDF export with stable client identity.
requirements.RC-1256: Demo export data is isolated from real user/client data.
requirements.RC-1257: Demo PDF requests cannot carry a real client ID.
requirements.RC-1258: Failed or cancelled PDF generation cleans its temporary partial file.
requirements.RC-1259: Successful PDF publication also leaves no temporary partial file.
requirements.RC-1260: PDF generation has an explicit cancellation token and cancellation checks.
requirements.RC-1261: Cancellation returns cancelled and can never be reported as completed.
requirements.RC-1262: Concurrent PDF generation is bounded by a global permit limit.
requirements.RC-1263: PDF jobs for the same client/report key are serialized to avoid races.
requirements.RC-1264: Filename collisions resolve deterministically without overwriting the prior path.
requirements.RC-1265: Output and sharing-cache paths are constrained to the declared app sandbox.
requirements.RC-1266: Android scoped-storage behavior requires physical/platform verification before DONE.
requirements.RC-1267: PDF sharing can stage a temporary file in an app-private share cache.
requirements.RC-1268: The temporary sharing/generation cache has explicit cleanup operations.
requirements.RC-1269: Foreground/background export behavior is explicit in the export request lifecycle mode.
requirements.RC-1270: A killed/interrupted process must never promote a partial file as successful output; physical lifecycle verification remains required.
requirements.RC-1271: Repeated report requests carry an explicit unique deterministic content-section order.
requirements.RC-1272: Release regression contains a versioned Free sample PDF fixture and renders it as a real PDF document.

release_blockers: Production PDF renderer/UI must wire the authorization request, demo watermark and cancellation coordinator end-to-end.
Android scoped-storage/share adapter must be verified on a physical/emulated Android runtime.
Process-kill/background lifecycle must be exercised against real platform storage to prove no partial file is promoted.
Exact release artifact and global PDF/Free-PRO gates remain required before VERIFIED/DONE.
